text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, argatroban is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 74 vials of the 50 mg/50 mL presentation (8.2 days) and 129 vials of the 250 mg/2.5 mL presentation (11.3 days). Corvale General holds 159 vials of the 50 mg/50 mL presentation (16.5 days). Both sites stock Eugia US LLC product (NDC 55150024101) manufactured at Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited in India (FEI 3008461619). Alternate manufacturers Accord Healthcare Inc., Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Caplin Steriles Limited, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC are not on the shortage list, but their labels do not identify a verifiable plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected the Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited plant on 2026-02-06 and classified it Official Action Indicated (OAI); the classification was posted on 2026-09-21. An earlier inspection ending 2024-02-02 also resulted in OAI classification, and a Warning Letter was issued on 2024-08-15.

Our position: Current inventory supports continued supply at both campuses. The Eugia plant has a recent OAI history, but no shortage exists and no FDA action links the inspection findings to an argatroban supply disruption. Alternate sources lack plant transparency.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 23 vials of argatroban 50 mg/50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Qualify Accord Healthcare Inc. as a backup supplier — approved by buyer.
3. Qualify Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as a backup supplier — approved by buyer.
4. Qualify Caplin Steriles Limited as a backup supplier — approved by buyer.
5. Qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as a backup supplier — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
